Hi Emily — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through Greenfield's procurement timeline. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the vendor onboarding/procurement milestones we discussed so procurement can start the Ariba/Coupa enrollment in parallel with contract negotiations.

High-level items in the attachment (Redwood_MAP_Greenfield_v1.pdf):
- Milestone 1 (Procurement intake): Greenfield completes vendor profile and returns vendor-onboard-form.xlsx — target 2026-09-10 — owner: Greenfield (Mike).
- Milestone 2 (W-9 & banking): Greenfield returns signed W-9 and bank verification docs — target 2026-09-14 — owner: Greenfield (Finance).
- Milestone 3 (Ariba/Coupa enrollment): Procurement approves vendor and submits paperwork to Ariba — target 2026-09-21 — owner: Redwood (Ben) / Greenfield procurement.
- Milestone 4 (PO & billing test): First PO issued and test invoice processed — target 2026-09-24 — owner: Greenfield finance / Redwood billing.
- Close target (go-live for Reserved Dedicated): 2026-09-30 (soft target, dependent on Ariba slot).

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm who will own the vendor profile (name + email) for the onboarding form? We left it as Mike Johnson in the draft.
2) Procurement told us they need a scanned W-9 and bank account verification (voided check or bank letter). I attached a vendor-onboard-form.xlsx to speed the intake.
3) If procurement requires Ariba supplier ID steps, cc vendor-support@ariba.com so we can coordinate timing.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Greenfield_v1.pdf, vendor-onboard-form.xlsx

If anything looks off in the sequencing, happy to adjust. Next step: once you confirm owners and attach W-9, Ben will start the Ariba/Coupa submission from our side.

Thanks — talk soon.
